items.title: Billy Bauer interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: he got us together... it was a band with strings and everything, a commercial date... he'd stop and he'd say, 'You're very important.'

ctx.x: Tell me about that, will you, the Stravinsky?
Was it Stravinsky or Stokowski? Stokowski. The conductor.
